description: This file implements a connection pooling mechanism for HTTP/2 clients, managing connection creation, reuse, and cleanup within the 'http2' package.

classes.name: clientConnPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of HTTP/2 client connections, handling connection acquisition, dialing, and cleanup.

classes.name: dialCall
classes.description: Represents an in-flight dial operation to establish a new client connection.

classes.name: addConnCall
classes.description: Represents an in-progress attempt to add a new connection to the pool.

classes.name: noDialClientConnPool
classes.description: A variant of the connection pool that never initiates new dials, used when reusing existing HTTP/1.x connections.

methods.name: GetClientConn
methods.description: Retrieves an existing or creates a new HTTP/2 client connection for a given request and address.

methods.name: MarkDead
methods.description: Marks a client connection as dead, removing it from the pool.

methods.name: closeIdleConnections
methods.description: Closes all idle connections in the pool.

methods.name: addConnIfNeeded
methods.description: Adds a new connection to the pool if none are available for the given key.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the process of creating a new client connection and adding it to the pool.

methods.name: getStartDialLocked
methods.description: Initiates a new dial operation if none are in progress for the specified address.

methods.name: dial
methods.description: Performs the actual dialing process to establish a new client connection.
